'''Garax Hadriin''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Hadriin was holding the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] and commanded a small [[Rebel Base (Garax Hadriin)|Rebel Base]] located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I believe that base's leader is General Garax Hadriin.|[[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]|<ref name="SWG:FtE" />}}
[[File:SWG_rebel_brigadier_general_Template.jpg|300px|thumb|Possible depiction of General Garax Hadriin]]
Garax Hadriin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Garax Hadriin was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

Since General Garax Hadriin spawned under the generic "rebel_brigadier_general" template utilizing six different Interchange File Formats, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, the in-game quest dialogue confirms Hadriin's actual gender to be male.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either Rebel Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Officer [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance. During the hunt for [[Cal Handro]] and the [[Syren spice]] on Rori, Rebel players had to attack an [[Imperial Base (Rori)|Imperial Base]] and kill Imperial General [[Brant Korra]] in order to collect incriminating evidence against Officer M'Kae.<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Alliance!"</ref> If the player instead chose the Empire, he/she would have to attack General Hadriin's base and kill Garax Hadriin to collect information about Wolff Kalos.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
